scope: Additive Royal Champion Rocket Spear L1-27 charged-throw count, damage and range audit.
game_version: Official June 2024 launch; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Super Wall Breaker Spotlight & New Hero Equipment!
facts: Rocket Spear is Epic Royal Champion Equipment with an active ability.
After activation, the next spears have greater damage and attack range; boosted spear count and extra damage depend on Equipment level.
sources.limitations: The event troop and medal acquisition are temporary. No exact current damage, count, range, projectile path, target, splash or tick order is given.

sources.title: Rocket Spear — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table matches pinned Royal Champion L1-27 HP bonus 50-700, DPS bonus 35-168 and ore costs.
sources.limitations: The source does not publish current charged-shot damage, count, range or projectile mechanics.

sources.title: Pinned Rocket Spear Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned levels list 7-10 charged attacks, 350-980 additional damage per shot, 10 tile attack range, 0.8 tile area damage radius, HP bonus 50-700 and DPS bonus 35-168.
sources.limitations: The payload does not define current continuity, projectile geometry, affected target types, damage stage, splash falloff, activation or consumption order.

derivations.result: Retain the pinned charged-throw count, extra damage, range and HP/DPS bonuses as catalogue provenance; current dated secondary confirms only HP/DPS and costs
derivations.method: Compare pinned raw level series against the official launch's qualitative contract and the dated 2026 numeric table without deriving projectile or activation order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the temporary Super Wall Breaker event troop or medal track as permanent combat content
rejected_inferences.reason: Only the Equipment is in scope; the event content was temporary acquisition context.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply 0.8 tile area damage to every unit and building under an assumed distance metric
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw label does not specify target eligibility, center, hitbox, wall interaction, damage falloff or projectile impact order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Consume one charge on target acquisition or at activation
rejected_inferences.reason: The official source says the next spear throws are boosted but does not fix launch versus hit consumption, missed shots or target loss.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply 350-980 as a standalone replacement damage value
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw key is damagePerShotIncrease and does not specify the damage stage or interaction with DPS bonuses, armor and other Equipment.

rejected_inferences.rule: Interpret 10 tiles as center-to-center range with immediate retargeting
rejected_inferences.reason: Geometry, collision and target selection are not published.

items: current charged-shot damage/count and 10 tile range continuity
activation, charge consumption, expiry, death and simultaneous Equipment order
projectile launch, travel, hit and miss timing on fixed 10 ms ticks
target eligibility, range metric, obstacle/collision and Royal Champion wall crossing
0.8 tile area damage center, affected entities and damage stage
HP/DPS bonus application and stacking with other Equipment
Viewer charged-shot effect, snapshot, replay and RL loadout state

conclusion: Rocket Spear L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official release establishes level-dependent boosted Royal Champion throws with more damage and range, and the dated table corroborates HP/DPS bonuses. Exact current charged-shot values and deterministic projectile, splash, charge and timing contracts remain unresolved. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
